# entry for each word, ahead of any WordNet senses ("in" is a preposition
# before it is an abbreviation for inch).

column3: Used before a noun to refer to one of something that has not been mentioned before, or to any member of a group: a book, a problem.
The form of "a" used before a vowel sound: an hour, an error.
Used before a noun to show that a particular, already known or unique thing is meant: the book on the table, the sun.
The person, thing or idea that is near, present, or has just been mentioned.
1. The person or thing further away or already mentioned. 2. Introduces a clause: she said that it works. 3. Which or who: the file that I saved.
Plural of "this": the people or things here or just mentioned.
Plural of "that": the people or things further away or already mentioned.
An amount or number that is not stated exactly; a part but not all.
One or some, no matter which; used mainly in questions and negatives: any questions?
Not any; not one. Also the negative reply, the opposite of "yes".
Each one of a group without exception: every page, every day.
Every one of two or more people or things, considered separately.
One or the other of two. With "or", introduces the first of two alternatives: either now or later.
Not one and not the other of two. With "nor": neither fast nor cheap.
The two together; the one as well as the other.
The whole quantity or every one of; everything or everyone.
One more of the same kind; a different one.
Different from the one already mentioned; the remaining one or ones.
Of the kind just described; so great or so much: such a result.
A large amount of; to a great degree. Used with uncountable nouns: much time.
A large number of. Used with countable nouns: many users.
Not many; a small number of.
More than two but not many.
The greatest amount or number; nearly all. Forms the superlative: most useful.
A greater amount or number. Forms the comparative: more secure.
A smaller amount of; to a smaller degree.
As much or as many as is needed.
Belonging to the person mentioned and to nobody else: its own address.
Not different; identical to the one mentioned.
Asks for information about something: what is a protocol? Also: the thing or things that — show me what you found.
Asks for a choice from a known set: which port? Also introduces a clause about a thing just mentioned: the key, which is secret.
Belonging to which person or thing: the user whose account was locked.
Anything or everything that; no matter what.
Any one that; no matter which.
The speaker or writer, as the subject of a verb.
The speaker or writer, as the object of a verb or preposition.
Belonging to the speaker or writer.
The one or ones belonging to the speaker or writer.
The speaker or writer as the object of their own action; also used for emphasis.
The person or people being spoken or written to.
Belonging to the person or people being addressed.
The one or ones belonging to the person or people being addressed.
The person addressed, as the object of their own action; also used for emphasis.
The male person or animal already mentioned, as subject.
The male person or animal already mentioned, as object.
Belonging to the male person already mentioned.
The male person mentioned, as the object of his own action; also for emphasis.
The female person or animal already mentioned, as subject.
The female person already mentioned, as object; also belonging to her.
The one or ones belonging to the female person already mentioned.
The female person mentioned, as the object of her own action; also for emphasis.
The thing, animal, idea or situation already mentioned; also an empty subject: it is raining.
Belonging to the thing or animal already mentioned: the bank and its customers. (Not "it's", which means "it is".)
The thing mentioned, as the object of its own action; also for emphasis.
The speaker or writer together with one or more other people, as subject.
The speaker or writer together with others, as object.
Belonging to the speaker or writer and others.
The one or ones belonging to us.
Us, as the object of our own action; also for emphasis.
The people, animals or things already mentioned, as subject; also used for one person whose gender is not stated.
The people, animals or things already mentioned, as object.
Belonging to the people or things already mentioned: customers and their accounts.
The one or ones belonging to them.
Them, as the object of their own action; also for emphasis.
Asks which person or people; also introduces a clause about a person: the officer who approved it.
The object form of "who": to whom it was sent.
Any person who; no matter who.
A person who is not known or not named.
A thing that is not known or not named.
Any person at all.
Any thing at all.
Every person.
All things; the whole of a situation.
Not any person.
Not any thing.
Not one; not any.
A person's own self, as the object of their own action.
1. Belonging to or connected with: the name of the file. 2. Made from or containing: a set of rules. 3. Showing a part or amount: one of them.
1. Inside or within a place, thing or period: in memory, in 2024. 2. Using a form or language: in binary.
1. Touching and supported by a surface: on the desk. 2. About: a book on networks. 3. At a time or day: on Monday. 4. Operating: the device is on.
Shows an exact place, time, rate or state: at the branch, at noon, at 5 percent.
1. In the direction of, or as far as: send it to the server. 2. Marks the person or thing affected: give it to them. 3. Marks the infinitive of a verb: to read.
1. Intended to be given to or used by: a card for customers. 2. In order to get or do: for security. 3. During: for two years. 4. Because (formal).
1. Together or in company of. 2. Using: sign with a key. 3. Having: a card with a chip.
1. Shows who or what does something: approved by the manager. 2. Using a method: pay by card. 3. Not later than: by Friday. 4. Next to.
Shows the starting point, source or cause: from the bank, from 9 to 5, made from steel.
To the inside of; to a new state or form: converted into binary, deposited into the account.
To a position on the surface of.
On (formal); immediately after: upon request.
1. On the subject of. 2. Approximately: about ten.
At or to a higher place or level than.
From one side to the other of; on the other side of.
Later than; following in time or order.
1. In opposition to. 2. Touching or pressing on. 3. As protection from: insurance against loss.
From one end towards the other of; together with.
In the middle of or included in a group of three or more.
On every side of; in a circle; approximately.
1. In the role of: works as a cashier. 2. While or because. 3. To the same degree: as fast as.
Earlier than; in front of.
At or to the back of; later or slower than.
At or to a lower place or level than.
Under; lower than.
Next to; at the side of.
In addition to; apart from; also.
In the space, time or range that separates two things; shared by two.
On the far side of; more than; outside the limits of.
1. Joins two contrasting ideas: fast but costly. 2. Except: nothing but zeros.
Without being affected or prevented by: despite the error.
To or at a lower place; not working: the server is down.
All through a period of time, or at some point in it.
Not including; other than.
In or into the inner part of.
Similar to; in the same way as; for example.
Close to; not far from.
Away from; not on or not operating: turn the device off.
Away from the inside of; not in; no longer available.
Not in; on or to the outer part of.
Above; more than; across; finished.
Beyond in place or time; later than.
For each: interest of 10 percent per year, bits per second.
1. From a past time until now: since 2020. 2. Because: since it is encrypted.
Used after a comparative to introduce the second thing compared: faster than disk.
From one side or end to the other of; by means of: paid through the app.
In every part of; during the whole of.
Until; up to the time of.
In the direction of; in relation to.
Below; less than; controlled or covered by.
Directly below or covered by.
Different from; not typical of.
Up to the time that; before.
To or at a higher place or level; working: the system is up.
By way of; by means of: sent via email.
Inside the limits of a place, time or range: within 24 hours.
Not having, using or doing: without a password.
Against; compared with. Abbreviated "vs".
About; on the subject of.
About; on the subject of.
Having as a part; and also.
Joins words, phrases or clauses that are to be taken together: input and output.
Joins alternatives: cash or card. Also introduces an explanation: RAM, or main memory.
And not; used after "neither" or another negative.
1. But; in spite of that. 2. Up to now: not yet finished.
1. Therefore; for that reason. 2. To such a degree: so fast. 3. In that way.
For the reason that.
In spite of the fact that; but.
1. During the time that. 2. Although; whereas.
Used to contrast two facts: RAM is volatile, whereas ROM is not.
On the condition that; supposing that; whether.
Except if; if not.
Shows a choice or doubt between alternatives: whether it is valid or not.
At what time; at or during the time that.
At any time that; every time that.
At, in or to what place; in the place or situation that.
In or to any place that.
1. One time only. 2. At some time in the past. 3. As soon as: once it is verified.
For this reason; therefore.
In this way; as a result.
For that reason; consequently.
1. But; nevertheless. 2. To whatever degree: however large.
In addition; what is more.
In spite of that; even so.
If not; in a different way; apart from that.
In the time between two events; at the same time.
In place of something else.
In addition; too.
1. Also; as well. 2. More than is wanted or needed: too slow.
In what way; by what means; to what extent: how it works, how many.
For what reason or purpose.
In, at or to this place or point.
In, at or to that place. Also introduces a statement that something exists: there are two types.
At that time; next; in that case.
At the present time; immediately.
Makes a word, phrase or sentence negative.
To a high degree: very fast. As an adjective: exact — the very same.
1. To exist or happen. 2. Links a subject to a description: the data is safe. 3. Forms continuous tenses (is running) and the passive (was sent).
First person singular present of "be": I am.
Third person singular present of "be": it is.
Present of "be" used with you, we and they.
Past of "be" used with I, he, she and it.
Past of "be" used with you, we and they; also used for unreal conditions: if it were true.
Past participle of "be": has been approved.
Present participle of "be": is being processed. As a noun: existence; a living creature.
1. To own, hold or contain. 2. Forms the perfect tenses: have finished. 3. "Have to": must.
Third person singular present of "have".
Past tense and past participle of "have".
Present participle of "have".
1. To perform or carry out an action. 2. Forms questions and negatives: do not open it. 3. Adds emphasis.
Third person singular present of "do".
Past tense of "do": performed, carried out.
Past participle of "do"; finished, completed.
Present participle of "do".
1. Shows the future: it will expire. 2. Shows willingness or a habit. (As a noun: determination; a legal document about property after death.)
1. Past of "will". 2. Shows a possible or imagined result: it would fail. 3. Makes a polite request.
1. Shows the future with I and we (formal). 2. In rules and contracts: must — the bank shall notify the customer.
1. Shows what is right, advised or expected: you should back up data. 2. Shows probability.
1. To be able to. 2. To be allowed to. 3. Shows possibility. (As a noun: a metal container.)
1. Past of "can". 2. Shows possibility: it could fail. 3. Makes a polite request.
1. Shows possibility: it may take a day. 2. Shows permission (formal).
Shows a weaker possibility than "may"; also the past of "may".
1. Shows necessity or obligation: you must sign. 2. Shows a logical conclusion: it must be correct.
Ought to: shows duty, advice or probability; similar to "should".
The negative of "can": not able or not allowed to.
Will not; refuses or is not going to.
Would not.
Should not.
Could not.
Must not; is forbidden to.
Do not.
Does not.
Did not.
Is not.
Are not.
Was not.
Were not.
Has not.
Have not.
Had not.
It is, or it has. (The possessive is "its", without an apostrophe.)
That is, or that has.
There is, or there has.
What is, or what has.
Let us; used to suggest doing something together.
I am.
I have.
I will.
I would, or I had.
You are.
You have.
You will.
We are.
We have.
We will.
They are.
They have.
They will.
He is, or he has.
She is, or she has.
For example (Latin "exempli gratia"). Introduces one or more examples.
That is; in other words (Latin "id est"). Introduces a restatement.
And so on; and other similar things (Latin "et cetera").
Namely; that is to say (Latin "videlicet").
Compare (Latin "confer"). Points the reader to something for comparison.
And others (Latin "et alii"). Used after the first of several authors.
Before noon (Latin "ante meridiem").
After noon (Latin "post meridiem").
